caption: The drawing depicts a large golden-brown eagle with detailed feathers and an outstretched wing perched atop a gold-colored cannon. The eagle faces left with its beak open and claws gripping the cannon. To the left of the cannon is a neatly stacked triangular pile of gold cannonballs arranged on a flat surface. The cannon has a prominent wheel with a spoke pattern and a curled decorative element extending from the axle. The background is a plain off-white or light beige with minor, faint discolorations in several areas. The composition is centered, with all objects rendered in shades of gold and brown, and there are no other objects or figures present in the drawing.
title: Eagle with Cannon
